FROM CAPABILITY TO VALUE CREATION

Make your professional contribution visible.

The workshop connects competence with the conduct others experience at work: how you communicate, solve problems, keep commitments and help the wider team succeed.

01

Competence and judgment

Diagnose the need, question assumptions and propose a useful next step.

02

Communication and ownership

Make the situation and required action clear; follow through and raise risks early.

03

Integrity and collaboration

Consider responsible conduct, confidentiality, feedback and the needs of others.

04

Continuous improvement

Identify one behaviour to strengthen and apply it through a practical commitment.

TWO AUDIENCES. ONE PROFESSIONAL INTENT.

Connect capability with contribution.
